content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to prevent the counter value from resetting to zero after loading an updated program into the [product_name]?
Yes, you can record the current counter value before uploading the new program and then set it as the initial value for the counter in your program. Refer to the attached document.

analysis.insight_summary: User notices that counter values are reset after updating the program in the [product_name]. This highlights a user experience issue related to loss of temporary data during program updates, requiring manual steps to restore the previous state. This disrupts automation processes and may cause frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects counter values to remain unchanged after program updates, or would prefer an automated solution to restore them without manual input.
